summary: @jtbartels this is quote I used to guide my instructional this year: Change yourself and you have done your part in the changing the the world. Every individual must change [their] own life if they want to live in a peaceful world. #lra18 --Paramahansa Yogananda

body_html:
@jtbartels this is quote I used to guide my instructional this year: Change yourself and you have done your part in the changing the the world. Every individual must change [their] own life if they want to live in a peaceful world. #lra18
--Paramahansa Yogananda
